attempts.label: NPU_full_generation124h
attempts.model_outcome: complete success on the model side: 50/50 DiT evaluations and the full VAE decode finished
attempts.failure: my own media-capture hook asserted that the raw output directory must live under /tmp/h3_align12401; I had put it under /tmp/h3_accel12501
attempts.classification: harness path error, not a numerical or model failure

attempts.label: NPU_full_generation124i
attempts.failure: driver assert len(counts)==8 and set(counts.values())=={49} failed with {} because no worker audit file was written
attempts.root_cause: sitecustomize calls configure_python_startup(), which asserts the private IPC key's parent is /tmp/h3_align12401; the key was under /tmp/h3_accel12501, so the exception was swallowed at interpreter startup and the alignment hook never installed in the workers
attempts.classification: harness environment error, not a numerical or model failure

attempts.label: NPU_full_generation124j
fixes: raw output directory placed under /tmp/h3_align12401 with the required name prefix
attempts.preflight: bootstrap_preflight125j.json reports configure_python_startup() succeeded with BOOTSTRAP_OK

conclusions_available_already: The flash-attention kernel carries the full 49-step trajectory without any numerical failure: two independent attempts completed every DiT evaluation and the VAE decode.
Engine-side warm step time falls from 38.33 s to 17.76 s (2.16x).
not_yet_claimed: No finished video/audio for the FA configuration yet, so no media comparison against the R124 baseline.
Whether the per-step deviations accumulate over 49 steps into a visible change is still unmeasured.
